summary: A press aide explains why advance copy helps careful reporting and also gives critics time to answer.
realLife: In discussing advance releases, Perlmeter recalled editors publishing opposing comments prominently and weighed that cost against the value of giving reporters time to prepare.
inGame: needs: planned release time and publication deadline.

turns.what: The aide distributes it with a release time.
turns.writesBack: Reporters can prepare questions and seek responses.

turns.what: The aide delays the copy and tells editors when to expect it.
